title: Go SDK: streaming schema factory, retry annotations, and ergonomic typed decoders
creator: Priya Natarajan
description:
Problem:
Teams building streaming LLM flows want typed, ergonomic decoding of structured outputs (JSON objects, jsonlines, and framed events) with clear semantics around retries. Current Go SDK helpers assume a single 'line-delimited JSON' framing and don't expose per-chunk retry safety signals. We need a model-agnostic factory for stream decoders, a decoder registry keyed by model+route/schema, and a small retry-annotation protocol that server responses can include to indicate whether a chunk is retry-safe.

Goals:
- Provide a StreamDecoderFactory that returns Decoder[T] for any typed struct T to keep strong typing in app code.
- Support multiple framings: json-lines, ndjson, framed-events ("event:" prefix), and envelope-with-retry-hint.
- Add a lightweight RetryHint concept in the response envelope: server may set retry_hint=partial|safe|none per-chunk. Client SDK uses this to determine if a backfilled request can be attempted without corruption.
- Keep public API ergonomic: minimal ceremony to get a typed streaming iterator that returns (T, meta) or an error.
- Ensure backwards compatibility: existing StreamDecoder helpers remain, but marked for deprecation once migration completes.

Scope (what this ticket does):
- Implement StreamDecoderFactory and Decoder[T] interface in go-sdk v0.27 runtime package.
- Implement decoder registry and a small DSL to register decoders for model+route combos.
- Add envelope parsing that extracts RetryHint and exposes it to retry middleware.
- Add unit tests, integration tests against the mock streaming server, and benchmark comparing throughput and allocations vs current helper.

Out of scope:
- Server-side changes beyond supporting the retry_hint field in our test harness (server rollout tracked in ENG-62001).
- Language SDKs other than Go (Python/TS follow-ups planned).
tasks: Design review: finalize StreamDecoderFactory API (open doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/12345678/Go+SDK+Streaming+Schema+Factory)
Add Decoder[T any] interface and concrete jsonlines/framed/ndjson implementations
Implement decoder registry and registration helpers for model+route keying
Parse per-chunk RetryHint and expose to middleware (RetryHint values: safe, partial, none)
Integrate with existing streaming transport layer and add Toggle flag for opt-in behavior
Add unit tests for each framing mode and error modes (malformed chunk, truncated JSON)
Add integration test against mock server with interleaved retry_hint values
Write migration guide for existing users and deprecation notes for old helpers
Benchmark and add results to perf dashboard (link in attachments)
acceptance_criteria: Public API: StreamDecoderFactory and Decoder[T] are documented and compiled in internal go-sdk module
Migration: existing example app compiles and can opt into new factory with minimal changes
Retries: SDK honours RetryHint==safe to attempt transparent retries of dropped connections without delivering duplicate/incomplete structs
Perf: new decoder path throughput within 10% of current helper on 8k avg chunk sizes, allocations reduced or similar
Tests: unit + integration coverage added and green on CI
Docs: design doc updated and short migration guide added to docs site
comments: 2026-02-12 Priya Natarajan: Kicked off design doc. Initial API sketch below. Prefer to expose a simple iterator pattern so app code looks like: iter := factory.New[T](resp.Body); for iter.Next() { item, meta := iter.Value(); }

2026-02-18 Ethan Cole: Implemented initial factory and decoder registry in feature branch (github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/879). Pushed jsonlines and framed-event decoders. Need review for error semantics when decoding partially emitted objects.

2026-02-22 Priya: Reviewed PR - main comments: make Err() return io.EOF only when stream truly ended, and expose the raw chunk bytes in StreamMeta for debug. Also: ensure RetryHint is available even when decoding error occurs (so retry middleware can see last hint).

2026-02-26 QA (Ana Morales): Found a race in decoder registry when concurrent register + lookups happen during SDK init. Suggested switching to sync.RWMutex and adding a one-time init path for registered baked-in decoders.

2026-03-03 Ethan: Added RetryHint enum parsing and unit tests. Server mock now emits header
{"retry_hint": "safe"} at chunk boundaries. Integration tests added to verify middleware will not attempt backfill when hint==none.

2026-03-07 Performance notes (Jamal Rahman): Benchmark shows new decoder allocs/op reduced by 22% vs legacy helper for 1k JSON objects stream. Throughput improved at higher concurrency because of reduced per-chunk allocations. Added results: https://dash.redwood.ai/bench/streaming-decoder-2026-03

2026-03-09 Design decision: Keep default behavior conservative. New factory opt-in via client.StreamingOptions.UseSchemaFactory=true. We won't change default until downstream SDK users migrate and we've monitored canary traffic on Dedicated. Decision recorded in design doc.
2026-03-10 Ethan: Preparing PR for merge. Remaining: write migration guide and update docs/examples. Target release sdk-go-0.27.0. Requesting review from @ana @jamal.
